content: As of mid-2026, iOS Safari 16.4+ supports Web Push for PWAs but ONLY after the user manually adds the site to Home Screen (Add to Home Screen); no push from a regular browser tab. Requires manifest display:standalone, service worker registered in installed context, permission request triggered by direct user gesture (not on page load), VAPID auth (RFC 8292), 4KB encrypted payload limit, and userVisibleOnly:true (no silent push). EU iOS 17.4+ users may lose PWA/push functionality due to DMA compliance changes -- must design a fallback (e.g. in-app notification badge/email) for EU-affected users. Notification backend architecture: listing published -> match against saved user alert rules (keyword+zone) -> push via web-push library routed through FCM (Chrome/Android) or APNs (iOS Safari).
